sources.name: Pocket Gamer
sources.analysis: Young Lady Blade is a Dark Physical DPS character strong in PvE due to her high AoE damage (300% ATK) and amplification (+150%). She's essential for maximising Blade's potential, particularly with Apostle. However, her low durability makes her less effective in PvP. She's a good choice for PvE and those who enjoy glass cannon playstyles.

sources.name: hostedgg.com
sources.analysis: A Fire Code Attacker on a shotgun, and a collab limited unit. Collab Nikkes typically never rerun, so pull now if you want her at all rather than banking on a second chance.

sources.name: hostedgg.com
sources.analysis: The second collab limited SSR, a Fire Code Attacker with a machine gun. Same logic as Queen: limited collab units are a now-or-never pull, so prioritize whichever fits your squad rather than splitting a small reserve across both.

sources.name: Game.Guide
sources.analysis: Sumire has a very confused kit. Her EX has a high multiplier for low cost and her normal skill is a strong attack steroid, and yet her passive and sub skills are both meant for tanks. Her equipment also reflects this as she has a tank gear set up even though she isn’t particularly tanky. Not a very good unit in general for pve, mainly use her if you need a cheap EX skill cycler.

sources.name: Game.Guide
sources.analysis: Akari is a powerful sustained DPS monster. She not only has a relatively cheap AoE nuke for mobbing, she also comes with two self attack steroids (albeit RNG ones). These both stack with each other which means she gets a huge amount of free stats. Best of all, she’s a farmable character with several nodes! Her only main drawback is that during transition phases, her buffs have a tendency to drop off so she takes a while to get going.

sources.name: Game.Guide
sources.analysis: Ah. The borgar. The crime against humanity. She that spooketh your gehenna rolls and then makes you die a bit inside. Izumi feels like BA looked at stamina in gbf, went “Oh wow this mechanic is broken”, and then pre-emptively decided to nerf her into the ground. She is essentially a backline tank. Which, for obvious reasons, isn’t very good. She’s usable if you have no other options.

sources.name: Game.Guide
sources.analysis: Another shotgun tank. Harukas kit is honestly pretty solid. Her main issue is that her EX skill doesn’t really do anything that a tank should do. It's pure damage even though she has no self steroids and her attack value is very low, along with giving no utility. She also needs a T4 bag to be even remotely viable.
